title: SWE-Dev: Evaluating and Training Autonomous Feature-Driven Software Development
authors_zh: Yaxin Du, Yuzhu Cai, Yifan Zhou, Cheng Wang, Yu Qian, Xianghe Pang, Qian Liu, Yue Hu, Siheng Chen
paper_type_zh: 可执行功能开发数据集、软件工程 benchmark 与训练环境
best_for_zh: 需要仓库级功能开发任务、单测奖励或软件工程 agent 训练数据的研究者。
one_line: SWE-Dev supplies 14,000 runnable feature-development training tasks and 500 test tasks where developer-authored unit tests score repository-level implementations.
SWE-Dev 提供 1.4 万个可运行的功能开发训练任务和 500 个测试任务，并以开发者编写的单测验证仓库级实现。
why: Its runnable test suites turn a repository-level development outcome into an executable feedback signal rather than a text-only code comparison.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Dev releases runnable feature-development records and developer-authored tests, so code outcomes can be independently executed and scored.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most software-engineering benchmarks evaluate fixing known bugs, while much real development adds new functionality to existing repositories from product requirements. Feature-driven development often spans functions and files, requiring dependency understanding, interface implementation, and developer tests. Function-level datasets lack repository context, and real issue corpora rarely provide training scale, runnable environments, and stable rewards together.

SWE-Dev reverse-constructs development tasks from complete implementations in existing repositories. It hides core implementation code, retains repository context and developer-authored unit tests, and generates product-requirement descriptions. The release contains 14K training and 500 test samples, each executable in its environment, supporting feature-development evaluation, SFT, and test-reward RL.

现有软件工程基准主要评测修复已知 bug，而真实开发中大量工作是根据产品需求在已有仓库中新增功能。功能驱动开发通常跨多个函数和文件，需要理解依赖、实现接口并满足开发者测试；已有函数级代码集缺少仓库上下文，真实 issue 数据又很少同时提供训练规模、可运行环境和稳定 reward。

SWE-Dev 将已有仓库中的完整功能实现反向构造成开发任务：隐藏核心实现，保留项目上下文和开发者编写的单元测试，再生成产品需求描述。它提供 14K 训练和 500 测试样本，每个实例都能在环境中执行，因此既可评估 feature development，也可用于 SFT 和以测试通过为奖励的 RL。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SWE-Dev’s core object is not a bug-fix patch but a feature-development instance containing a PRD, incomplete repository, complete implementation, developer tests, and execution environment. From 8,000 popular PyPI packages, the authors retain 1,072 verifiable repositories and 9,314 executable test files. Dynamic tracing maps tests to call trees, core tested functions are hidden, and the original implementation becomes ground truth. The dataset has 14,000 training and 500 test records, with the test set manually divided into 250 easy and 250 hard tasks; an average task requires roughly 190 lines across multiple files. Unit tests filter construction and provide terminal rewards for SFT, RL, and evaluation.

SWE-Dev 的核心数据对象不是补丁修复，而是“PRD—不完整仓库—完整实现—开发者测试—执行环境”的功能开发实例。作者从 8,000 个热门 PyPI 包筛选出 1,072 个可验证仓库和 9,314 个可执行测试文件，通过动态 tracing 将测试映射到调用树，隐藏被测试覆盖的核心函数，并以原实现作为 ground truth。训练集 14,000 条，测试集 500 条并人工分成 250 easy/250 hard；平均任务涉及约 190 行代码和多个文件。单元测试既用于过滤数据，也在 SFT/RL/评测中提供终局 reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Filter executable projects: Collect repositories from popular PyPI packages, install dependencies, and run original tests. Retain only projects and test files that pass reliably in Docker.
  1. Locate feature boundaries: Use Python tracing to record call trees triggered by tests, map developer tests to relevant implementations, and select core functions or classes that can be hidden independently.
  1. Create incomplete repositories: Remove or replace target implementations while preserving interfaces, context, and tests. The original code becomes the gold implementation; tests must fail after hiding and pass after restoration.
  1. Generate PRDs and splits: Produce product-requirement descriptions from the original implementation, call relations, and tests. Manually inspect 500 test instances and group them by difficulty. Reproduction requires fixed commits, containers, test selection, and masking rules to avoid duplicate implementations elsewhere.

1. 筛选可执行项目： 从热门 PyPI 包获取仓库，自动安装依赖并运行原测试；只保留 Docker 中可稳定通过的项目与测试文件。
  1. 定位功能边界： 用 Python tracing 记录测试触发的函数调用树，将开发者测试映射到相关实现，并选择适合独立隐藏的核心函数或类。
  1. 构造不完整仓库： 删除或替换目标实现，保留接口、上下文和测试；原始代码成为 gold implementation，执行测试确认隐藏后任务失败、恢复后通过。
  1. 生成 PRD 与划分： 根据原实现、调用关系和测试生成产品需求描述，人工检查 500 个测试实例并按难度分组。复现需固定 commit、容器、测试选择和遮蔽规则，防止其他文件残留同功能实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The benchmark evaluates 17 chat models, 10 reasoning models, and 10 multi-agent systems. Even Claude-3.7-Sonnet reaches only 22.45% Pass@3 on the hard split, showing that the task is not ordinary completion. Fine-tuning a 7B model on the 14K training set raises its hard-split result from about 6.68% to 18.89%, approaching GPT-4o, and RL experiments show that executable tests provide useful rewards. This supports both difficulty and training value. However, PRDs are reconstructed from known implementations and all tests come from the PyPI ecosystem, making tasks more constrained than true design from requirements; model comparisons also depend on scaffolds and sampling counts.

基准评测覆盖 17 个聊天模型、10 个 reasoning model 和 10 个多 agent 系统；即使 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 在 hard split 的 Pass@3 也只有 22.45%，说明任务不是普通补全。作者再在 14K 训练集上微调 7B 模型：其 hard split 结果由约 6.68% 提高到 18.89%，接近 GPT-4o；RL 实验也显示可执行测试能提供有效奖励。该证据支持数据兼具难度与训练价值，但 PRD 来自已知实现、测试集来自同一 PyPI 生态，可能比真实从需求到设计的开发更受约束；模型比较还受 agent scaffold 和采样次数影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SWE-bench-style data constructs repair tasks from issues and patches, while HumanEval-style data maps natural language to isolated functions. The former omits new-feature development and the latter lacks repository complexity. SWE-Dev instead reverse-extracts a feature from a complete, test-covered implementation: dynamic call graphs define the boundary, code is masked, and a PRD is generated, allowing original developer tests to become natural verifiers. This is not merely renaming bug fixes. The data object changes to an incomplete repository plus requirement document, with both a 14K training set and 500 manually checked evaluation tasks.

SWE-bench 类数据从 issue 和补丁构造修复任务，HumanEval 类数据则从自然语言生成单函数；二者分别缺少新增功能场景或仓库级复杂度。SWE-Dev 的变化是从“测试覆盖的完整实现”反向抽取 feature：通过动态调用图确定实现边界，再遮蔽代码并生成 PRD，使原开发者测试自然成为 verifier。它不只是把 bug fix 改名为 feature，而是把数据对象改为不完整仓库和需求文档，并同时提供 14K 训练规模与 500 人工检查评测任务。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Reverse-task bias: PRDs are generated from existing implementations and tests, so requirements align closely with a unique gold implementation and omit ambiguity, design negotiation, and multiple valid solutions. PRDs should be compared with real issues, and non-gold patches passing tests should be accepted.
  1. Test coverage: Masking boundaries come from traced tests and capture only executed behavior; uncovered requirements cannot enter the verifier. Reuse should run full and hidden tests and report flaky rates.
  1. Ecosystem and leakage: The corpus focuses on Python and PyPI, and train and test tasks may share library patterns or near-duplicate implementations. External models may also have seen public repositories. Splits should be repository- and time-aware, with deduplication and frozen containers.

1. 逆向任务偏置： PRD 根据现成实现和测试生成，需求通常与唯一 gold code 高度对齐，缺少真实产品开发中的歧义、设计协商和多种正确实现。应人工比较 PRD 与真实 issue，并允许测试通过的非 gold 方案。
  1. 测试覆盖： 隐藏边界由 tracing 决定，只能捕获已运行测试触达的行为；测试未覆盖的需求不会进入 verifier。复用时应运行全量测试、检查隐藏测试并报告 flaky rate。
  1. 生态与泄漏： 数据集中于 Python/PyPI，训练和测试可能共享库模式或近似实现；外部模型也可能见过开源仓库。必须按仓库与时间切分、去除重复实现，并冻结容器和依赖。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Feature-development SFT: Train agents on PRDs, incomplete repositories, and gold implementations to localize, edit, and implement features. Split by repository and compute Pass@1 with developer tests plus full regression suites.
  1. Test-reward RL: Use relevant test pass rates as rewards in containers and preserve commands, logs, and failure types. Label compilation failures, timeouts, and assertion failures separately to prevent agents from exploiting infrastructure.
  1. Evaluate feature agents: Use the 500-task easy/hard split to compare single agents, reasoning models, and multi-agent systems. For requirement clarification, architecture design, or non-Python systems, SWE-Dev covers only implementation and needs additional human or specification-based evaluation.

1. 功能开发 SFT： 用 PRD、不完整仓库和 gold implementation 训练 agent 定位、编辑与实现功能；按仓库划分，并用开发者测试和全量回归测试计算 Pass@1。
  1. 测试奖励 RL： 在容器中把相关单测通过率作为 reward，保存命令、日志和失败类型；对编译失败、超时和断言失败分别标注，防止 agent 学习环境漏洞。
  1. 评测新功能 agent： 采用 500 题 easy/hard split 比较单 agent、reasoning model 和 MAS。若研究对象是需求澄清、架构设计或非 Python 系统，SWE-Dev 只覆盖实现阶段，需要额外的人类或规格评测。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-Dev reverse-constructs PRDs and incomplete repositories from tested Python features, releasing 14K training and 500 evaluation tasks.
  1. Method takeaway: Environment validation, dynamic call tracing, implementation masking, before–after test checks, and PRD generation determine quality.
  1. Data takeaway: Each record contains a PRD, repository, gold code, developer tests, and environment; the test set has 250 manually checked easy and 250 hard tasks.
  1. Evidence anchor: Claude-3.7 reaches only 22.45% hard Pass@3, while 7B SFT raises hard performance from about 6.68% to 18.89%.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits feature-driven agent SFT and RL. Reverse-generated PRDs and test blind spots require acceptance of non-gold solutions and full regression testing.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-Dev 从已测试的 Python 功能反向生成 PRD 和不完整仓库，发布 14K 训练与 500 评测任务。
  1. 方法抓手： 环境验证、动态调用 tracing、遮蔽核心实现、测试前后检查和 PRD 生成决定任务质量。
  1. 数据抓手： 每条含 PRD、repo、gold code、开发者测试与环境；测试集按 250 easy/250 hard 人工检查。
  1. 证据锚点： Claude-3.7 hard Pass@3 仅 22.45%；7B SFT 的 hard 结果约由 6.68% 升至 18.89%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 feature-driven agent SFT/RL；最大风险是逆向 PRD 与测试盲区，必须允许非 gold 正解并做全量回归。
